items.summary: The heated Memphis City Council meeting was shut down after council members voted 7-5 to postpone a vote on a proposed data center moratorium.

items.title: Google Lets You Build a Video Game by Typing a Description
items.summary: Google's Playground turns a typed description into a playable, shareable game, no coding required. It's live for U.S. adults, with creation access tiered by Google AI subscription.

items.title: Why the AI guys built tech that terrifies them
items.summary: AI leaders like Dario Amodei want to win the AI race — and they also want to slow the race down. That makes sense, says journalist Kevin Roose.

items.title: Dropbox’s CTO wants every employee at the cloud-storage company to use AI. He’s letting them find their own ways to use it
items.summary: Dropbox CTO Ali Dasdan has focused on making AI tools widely available and empowering employees to experiment, rather than mandating usage from the top.
items.titleZh: Dropbox的首席技术官希望这家云存储公司的每一位员工都能使用人工智能。他让他们找到自己的使用方式
items.summaryZh: Dropbox首席技术官Ali Dasdan一直致力于让人工智能工具广泛可用，并授权员工进行实验，而不是从高层强制使用。

items.title: The great Boomer hoard: Americans 55 and over hold $140 trillion, roughly three-quarters of total net worth
items.summary: Older households' net worth rose more than 20% in two years on the back of an AI-fueled stock rally, and boomers hold most of it.
items.titleZh: 婴儿潮一代的巨额财富：55岁及以上的美国人持有140万亿美元，约占总净值的四分之三
items.summaryZh: 在人工智能推动的股市上涨的推动下，老年家庭的净资产在两年内增长了20%以上，而婴儿潮一代持有其中的大部分。
